placements.title: Instrument calibration and verification as an organizational category

placements.title: Calibration status is established through verification against reference standards
placements.frame: What instrument's calibration is being asserted as current, and what reference artifact grounds that verification?
placements.why: All three expressions converge on the same thematic subject — the Kestrelwood spectrograph's calibration at 88.4 MHz, verified against the June reference plates — rendered once in prose (src-1) and twice more as structured field restatements (src-2, src-3). This names a subject future calibration envelopes will keep feeding (new instruments, new reference sets, re-verifications), not a one-time fact: the fact of 88.4 MHz/June plates is the evidence, the theme is 'calibration status established via reference verification.' No existing leaf structure was supplied to reuse, so this is a genuine mint, nested under the newly minted Calibration strata as its natural home.
